svg.desc: Median time to first audio at 1, 2, 4 and 8 codec frames per first packet, with a linear fit of 79.5 plus 28.6 milliseconds per frame, and its server-side stages: prefill and unattributed engine time stay near 40 ms while first-packet decode grows linearly from 28 to 220 ms.
